_infer_rep_and_customer falls back silently to 'Unknown Rep'/'Unknown' on any exception — logs a warning but the UI has no surfacing. Consider returning an 'extraction_confidence' field so the dashboard can flag auto-detection failures.
BulkUpload.jsx is 250 lines with inline SAMPLE_CSV. Acceptable for MVP, but the Results sub-component + SummaryTile could move to /components/bulk/ for reuse on a future 'batch history' page.

The bulk endpoint runs LLM calls sequentially via _run_bulk. For 100+ transcripts this will be slow (~5-8s each). Action: consider asyncio.gather with a semaphore (e.g., 5 concurrent) to keep under 60s for 20-row batches.
